The Lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, was almost entirely destroyed by earthquakes, with very little of the original structure surviving.

category: Units of Instantaneous Electrical Properties or Rate
explanation: Volt, Ampere, Ohm, and Watt are fundamental SI units used to describe instantaneous electrical properties (voltage, current, resistance) or the rate of energy transfer (power) in an electrical circuit. Joule, however, is a unit of total energy, representing work done or energy consumed over a period, rather than an instantaneous measure.
